baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative ٱتَّقُوا۟ joined directly to رَبَّكُمْ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The command asks the addressees to place themselves in protection through alignment with a Lord whose relation is formative and reparative. Protection is therefore relational discipline, not a free-standing shield.

activation_trace.role: The reflexive protective image makes the imperative an adopted stance in which the self is placed under guard.
The image of repair, nurture, and completion identifies the protective relation as ongoing formation by the Lord.

changed_reading.before: Fear your Lord because a terrible event is coming.
changed_reading.after: Deliberately enter a protective relation with the One who forms and repairs you, because ordinary stability will not protect itself.

baseline_models.mechanism: The nominal assertion turns the Hour's shaking into an intelligible actuality, while the shaking and severe-visitation branches describe an event that dislodges settled structures rather than merely inspiring vague dread.

activation_trace.role: Oscillation and disturbance supply the event's physical and systemic mode of action.
The knowable, reportable thing-image gives the warning objective rather than merely affective force.
The severe descending visitation image makes greatness the event's capacity to land as an overwhelming crisis.

changed_reading.before: The future earthquake is very large.
changed_reading.after: A definite destabilizing actuality is being reported, great because it can arrive as a severe visitation that dislodges what seemed settled.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The address to ٱلنَّاسُ before the report of زَلْزَلَة.
baseline_models.mechanism: The people-branch foregrounds human visibility and familiarity, while the quake removes steadiness. The universal address can thus be heard as summoning familiarity-bearing social beings whose ordinary means of mutual reassurance are themselves vulnerable.

activation_trace.role: The familiarity that dispels estrangement supplies the social order presupposed by the address.
Disturbance functions as the force that can unsteady both bodies and their familiar relations.
The image of an event becoming immense in the self supplies the affective scale of lost reassurance.

changed_reading.before: People is simply the widest possible audience.
changed_reading.after: Humanity is addressed precisely as a world of familiar, mutually reassuring persons that the coming disturbance can render unable to steady itself.

context_deltas.mechanism: The first contextual expansion measures the quake by the failure of nested holding systems: attention leaves the nursing relation, inner carrying is discharged, and collective recognition becomes intoxication-like. Greatness is relational load-breaking, not only seismic amplitude.

activation_trace.role: Nurture and completion establish the stable caregiving relation against which the following rupture is measured.
The severe-visitation image receives a concrete relational measure in the next ayah.
Loss of attention supplies the first break in a caregiver's active holding of another.
Milk-kinship supplies an embodied bond strong enough to make its interruption a measure of the quake.
The birth-unloading image turns disturbance into forced release of what was held within.
Inner carrying supplies the contained continuity that the event abruptly terminates.
Loss of sobriety supplies the collective perceptual analogue of physical shaking.

structural_cues: 22:2 moves from a caregiver's attention, to pregnancy, to the visible condition of all people.
The repeated universal كُلُّ scales intimate ruptures into a general human condition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent failures of attention, nursing, carrying, and sobriety; I infer one pressure crossing successive layers of human holding. A live alternative is that these are parallel severity images without a single nested mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The quake is great because its physical motion is enormous.
changed_reading.after: The quake is great because it can unfasten the deepest embodied and social forms of holding by which human life continues.

context_deltas.mechanism: The dead earth later moves, rises, and grows after water. That sequence gives shaking a second polarity: destabilization can be the threshold motion by which a fixed dead state is broken open into renewed life.

activation_trace.role: Disturbance supplies the opening motion that the later earth sequence revalues.
The non-dominant mapped image of nourishment and growth makes lordly formation compatible with disruptive transition.
Earth and vegetation stirring with life supplies a visibly generative kind of shaking.
Increase and rising make the motion a transition from flat lifelessness toward emergent form.
Growth out of earth supplies the life-producing result of the movement.

structural_cues: 22:5 places اهتزت, ربت, and أنبتت in immediate sequence after water reaches dead earth.
The earth sequence follows the staged formation, death, and return of human bodies in the same ayah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a dead-earth sequence in which motion precedes rising and growth; I project that transformational pattern back onto the focus quake. The live alternative is that 22:5 proves resurrection while leaving the opening quake wholly destructive.

changed_reading.before: The Hour's shaking only destroys an existing order.
changed_reading.after: The shaking is also a threshold operation: it breaks the fixity of a dead order so that another mode of life can emerge.

context_deltas.mechanism: Worship positioned on a tilting margin remains calm only while benefit arrives; testing then flips it away and exposes total loss. The opening protective stance is therefore durable orientation under reversal, not a bargain that occupies the edge of commitment.

activation_trace.role: Self-placement in protection supplies the stable stance contrasted with marginal worship.
Inclination away from a direction makes the marginal position dynamically unstable.
Assaying metal or a person supplies the pressure that reveals whether the stance has depth.
Turning a thing from its face supplies the reversal produced by a shallow orientation.
General diminution supplies the result when an exposed stance is overturned.

structural_cues: 22:11 balances two conditions: benefit produces calm, while trial produces reversal.
The phrase على حرف gives the conditional sequence a spatially exposed posture.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a marginal posture, an assay, reversal, and loss; I infer that taqwa names the resilient contrary posture. A live alternative is a critique of fickleness without any shelter or stability mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Guarding oneself means seeking favorable outcomes from the Lord.
changed_reading.after: Guarding oneself means moving off the exposed margin into a relation that remains oriented when benefit turns into trial.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening calls the event great; later, humans actively magnify signs, and that act is located in the hearts' taqwa. The reach contrast then excludes meat and blood while allowing taqwa to reach. Protective orientation becomes an inward calibration of value expressed through, but not reducible to, ritual matter.

activation_trace.role: Greatness and force supply the event's objective magnitude at the opening.
The adopted protective stance supplies the response whose interior location is later exposed.
Actively making something great turns magnitude from a property perceived into a valuation enacted.
Protective self-placement is named as the source from which magnification proceeds.
The heart-image locates the operative protection in an interior center rather than in the ritual object.
Attainment and reaching establish the contrast between material that does not arrive and taqwa that does.
The protective stance is the non-material element that crosses the reach boundary.

structural_cues: 22:32 causally locates magnifying the signs in taqwa of the hearts.
22:37 uses a negated material pair followed by وَلَٰكِن to isolate taqwa as what reaches.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated ع ظ م and و ق ي roots plus an explicit heart-location and reach contrast; I infer a reciprocal calibration between recognizing greatness and enacting it. A live alternative is that the later passages define ritual sincerity without revising the opening warning.

changed_reading.before: Taqwa is an external shield proportionate to a great external threat.
changed_reading.after: Taqwa is the heart's truthful calibration to greatness, made visible in practice while remaining irreducible to ritual material.

context_deltas.mechanism: Protection becomes distributed across divine defense and the checking of people by people, with the preservation of multiple worship spaces as the result. The universal address can carry a social duty to resist destructive force, not only private self-sheltering.

activation_trace.role: The barrier against harm supplies the protective function later enacted through دفع.
Visible humanity supplies the collective field in which protection must operate.
Driving away a hated thing supplies divine defense as an active form of protection.
The same repelling image becomes a reciprocal social counterforce that blocks destruction.
The repeated people-root makes humanity both the protected addressee and the medium of checking force.
The collapse of built structures supplies the concrete harm prevented by communal counteraction.

structural_cues: 22:38 states divine defense; 22:40 repeats the same root in a counterfactual involving people checking people.
The لَوْلَا construction makes demolition of worship spaces the prevented outcome.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine repelling, reciprocal human repelling, and prevented demolition; I map دفع as an enacted analogue of وقاية and infer a communal layer. A live alternative confines these ayahs to a historical or legal setting without extending the opening imperative.

changed_reading.before: Each person privately seeks protection from the coming quake.
changed_reading.after: The addressed people also inhabit a protective social order in which destructive force is checked so shared spaces of orientation can endure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Hour arrives without preparatory interval, while the coordinated alternative is a barren day. Together they frame the temporal endpoint as interruption of both postponement and further production.

activation_trace.role: The branch image of the perished gives the temporal anchor an exploratory terminal horizon.
Disturbance supplies the abrupt mode by which ordinary temporal continuity is broken.
Surprise removes any usable warning interval from the arrival.
Sterility in womb and offspring supplies an endpoint that cannot generate another postponing future.

structural_cues: 22:55 extends doubt with حَتَّىٰ and then terminates it through two coordinated arrivals.
The alternatives pair the sudden Hour with punishment on a day described as barren.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sudden arrival and a coordinated barren day; I infer a shared closure logic in which delay and reproduction both run out. The materially live alternative keeps barrenness attached only to the punishment day, not to the Hour.

changed_reading.before: The Hour is a future date at which a disaster happens.
changed_reading.after: The Hour is the abrupt terminal cutoff that makes continued doubt, delay, and production of another future impossible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sky does not remain aloft by inert normality; it is actively held from falling, with release excepted by permission and the whole statement closed by compassion toward people. The quake is therefore read inside a governed field of maintained stability, not as an autonomous breakdown.

activation_trace.role: A barrier that drives off harm supplies the human response to a world whose stability also depends on protection.
Lordship and ownership supply the governing agency behind maintained or released stability.
Holding and restraining make non-collapse an active operation rather than a default state.
Falling and coming to rest supply the withheld outcome of the cosmic holding.
Tender compassion identifies the maintained order as care directed toward people.

structural_cues: 22:65 makes falling the complement of active holding and then inserts an exception by permission.
The ayah closes the cosmological mechanism with an explicit relation of compassion to people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies active holding, a withheld fall, permission, and compassion; I infer that the focus quake is a governed release or reconfiguration of maintained order. A live alternative reads 22:65 only as present preservation with no specification of the quake's agency.

changed_reading.before: The quake is nature losing its normal stability, so people must find a shield.
changed_reading.after: Normal stability is itself continuously held in mercy; taqwa aligns people with its Lord before an authorized reconfiguration of that held order.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing imperatives repeat service to the Lord, require full exertion, deny constriction in the path, and culminate in protective holding to God. The opening taqwa becomes a practiced grip: strenuous without being a trap, and secure because its object is the patron who protects.

activation_trace.role: Self-placement in protection supplies the opening posture that the final command operationalizes.
The repeated formative Lord relation reconnects the closing acts to the opening addressee-Lord bond.
Expenditure of capacity under difficulty makes protection an active discipline rather than passive refuge.
The denied constriction prevents disciplined protection from being modeled as entrapment.
A holding that prevents and preserves supplies the final concrete action corresponding to taqwa.

structural_cues: 22:77 repeats the imperative to serve رَبَّكُمْ near the surah's close.
22:78 moves from exertion, through negated constriction, to the imperative ٱعْتَصِمُوا۟ and the patron-helper conclusion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated Lord-address, exertion, no constriction, and preserving attachment; I read them as the closing mechanics of the opening taqwa. A live alternative treats them as parallel duties without making اعتصام an explication of اتقوا.

changed_reading.before: Taqwa is an initial warning posture taken in anticipation of danger.
changed_reading.after: Taqwa is sustained exertion that ends in a preserving grip on God: effortful, non-constricting, and grounded in patronage rather than self-sufficiency.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The reading is surprising because it lets a fly and a stolen item recalibrate the adjective great; it remains valid as a functional analogy anchored in the repeated ش ي ء root and the focus magnitude construction. Downstream prose should present it as a scale inversion about agency, not as a claim that the quake is physically small or that the two scenes are identical.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: شَىْءٌ عَظِيمٌ in 22:1, reactivated by شَيْـًٔا in 22:73.

activation_trace.role: The reportable thing supplies the repeated object whose functional scale can be compared.
Greatness and force pose the question of what makes a thing overwhelming.
The fly supplies a physically tiny agent that nevertheless defeats the claimants' power.
The repeated generic thing makes even an unspecified small loss diagnostically decisive.
Failure to extract an item from another's grasp supplies the collapse of recovery agency.
The opposite-of-strength image identifies incapacity, rather than physical size, as the operative scale.

changed_reading.before: The quake is great because the event itself is unimaginably large.
changed_reading.after: Its greatness can also be measured by agency asymmetry: as a tiny theft defeats every pretended power, the Hour makes all apparent powers unable to recover what is taken.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates a causative carrying sense under the focus's ordinary indefinite noun; it remains anchored in شَىْءٌ and gains a visible reversal from the carriers who unload in 22:2. Downstream prose must label it an exploratory functional wordplay, not a translation or an etymological assertion.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: شَىْءٌ as the grammatical predicate naming the quake in 22:1.

activation_trace.role: The branch image of carrying or compelling someone toward a matter lets the named event function as an enforcing agent.
The severe visitation supplies the force by which the event compels rather than merely sits as an object.
Inner carrying supplies the human containment that is forced to terminate.
Unloading by birth supplies the event's visible effect on every human carrier.

changed_reading.before: The quake is simply classified as an immense thing.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is the compelling thing that takes over agency: the event carries everyone into its matter while human carriers can no longer retain what they carry.

strongest_changes: Magnitude shifts from physical size to the capacity to unfasten caregiving, carrying, sobriety, and familiar human order.
The dead earth's movement, rising, and growth give shaking a regenerative polarity alongside destruction.
Taqwa becomes durable inner orientation, communal counterforce, and finally a preserving grip on God within an actively held cosmos.
The fly parable permits a scale inversion in which greatness is measured by defeated agency rather than bulk.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence repeatedly reverses the opening terms: destructive shaking is mirrored by life-bearing movement, an objectively great event calls forth human magnification from the heart, private guarding expands into divine and social defense, and the opening protective imperative closes as preserving attachment.
remaining_uncertainties: The generative reading depends on projecting the dead earth's life-bearing movement back onto the Hour's distinct shaking.
The barren-day image may remain grammatically separate from the Hour rather than sharing its terminal logic.
The communal defense sequence may extend the opening protection thematically without defining the imperative itself.
The compelling-thing outlier is deliberately branch-distant and should not enter an unqualified translation.
